prompt_zh: 将上传参考图中的人物或宠物转化为精致 1/7 比例 PVC 桌面手办模型，站在[底座风格]上，保留标志性服饰与五官神韵，[光影材质]

variables.label: 展示底座
variables.default_value: round translucent acrylic display base on an artist workbench
options: round translucent acrylic display base on an artist workbench
miniature mossy cobblestone diorama plinth
sleek brushed aluminum pedestal inside a lit glass showcase

variables.label: 手办质感
variables.default_value: subtle satin PVC paint finish and soft natural window light
options: subtle satin PVC paint finish and soft natural window light
matte vinyl toy finish with playful studio rim lighting
glossy ceramic glaze with warm desk lamp highlights
